summary: Narrow bend with homes at the kerb and no cars parked.
reasons: Houses 2 m and 7 m from kerb
No parked cars or parking lane
Narrow lane beside lawns and fences

best_section.where: Market Street North bend, beside the lawn between the two houses

drivers.seclusion: Homes face the kerb along the whole stretch; the nearest is 2 m away at 14 m and 7 m away at 55 m. Even the lawn gap has a house about 10 m off.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow bend with kerb against lawns and fences; no cars parked and no pull-off beside the lane.
drivers.traffic: Highway runs just south across a verge; steady noise.
drivers.convention: No parked cars seen and no parking convention.

flags: Low-lying: 6.2 m elevation, creek about 49 m away
Noise from the multi-lane road just south
sun_shade: Open sun on the lawn side; trees along the south verge shade from the south.
